title: TAZ OS Identity
description: Globally unique identity for every object in TAZ OS: humans, harnesses, agents, tools, workflows, memory, artifacts, documents, policies. See Volume 8.

id.description: Globally unique. Format: <TYPE>-<NNNNNN>. Human=HUM, Harness=HAR, Agent=AGT, Tool=TOL, Policy=POL, Artifact=ART, Workflow=WRK, Memory=MEM, Document=DOC, Project=PRJ, Customer=CUS, Supplier=SUP, Investor=INV, Meeting=MTG, Task=TSK.

owner.description: ID of the owning identity (harness, human, or org). May be null for root.
